faqs.q: What are Bijur Delimon gear spray lances used for?
faqs.a: Bijur Delimon gear spray lances spray grease or oil on to the teeth of large open gears, such as girth gears on mills and kilns and open gear drives on crushers and draglines, where there is no sump. The listing has 115 part numbers.

faqs.q: How do I read Bijur Delimon gear spray part numbers such as IH-BD-36694-1C1?
faqs.a: Indus part numbers are IH-BD- followed by the Bijur Delimon item number, so IH-BD-36694-1C1 is item 36694-1C1, the gear spray kit for a 120 lb drum, 115 VAC, with 1 nozzle (1NZ). The item names in the size table give the point count, such as 2P or 4-POINT.

faqs.q: How many spray points does a Bijur Delimon gear spray lance have?
faqs.a: Lances carry two, three or four spray points as described, sized to the gear face width, and the table lists larger point counts too, for example LD93279450S is a 9P lance. Choose on gear face width, pitch-line speed and lubricant.

faqs.q: How do I size a gear spray lance for my open gear?
faqs.a: Size the spray on the gear face width and pitch-line speed, and the lubricant (open-gear grease or oil) on the gear maker’s recommendation. The number of nozzles follows the face width; clean, dry atomising air keeps the pattern even.

faqs.q: What are the gear spray kits for 120 lb drums?
faqs.a: The gear spray kits for 120 lb drums (115 VAC) come with one, two or three nozzles: 36694-1C1, 36694-2C1 and 36694-3C1. They run an air-atomised spray on open-gear grease.

faqs.q: What parts besides lances does the listing include?
faqs.a: The table also lists spray valve panels (for example LD137185, a 5 PT valve panel assembly, and LD12361V2, a 2 PT panel) and an accumulator, M11. See the [gear spray nozzles and spray valves](/p/bijur-delimon-gear-spray-nozzles-and-spray-valves) for replacement nozzles.

faqs.q: What lubricant does a Bijur Delimon gear spray system use?
faqs.a: Open-gear grease or oil, chosen on the gear maker’s recommendation. The drive is air-atomised spray, so clean, dry atomising air is needed; confirm the lubricant grade and NLGI class on the enquiry.

faqs.q: Where are gear spray lances used?
faqs.a: They are used on cement kilns and ball mills, mining mills, crushers and draglines, and any external gear drive with a dry sump.

faqs.q: Gear spray lances or valve panels: which part do I need?
faqs.a: A lance carries the spray points over the gear face, while a spray valve panel meters the lubricant to each point. If a nozzle only needs replacing, see the [nozzles and spray valves](/p/bijur-delimon-gear-spray-nozzles-and-spray-valves) listing.

faqs.a: Yes. We supply the Bijur Delimon lubricators, distribution, tubing, fittings, controller and monitoring to match, sized to the number of points and the lubricant. Send the machine and the lubrication points and we propose the layout; see the [gear spray lubrication shelf](/c/gear-spray-lubrication).

faqs.q: What are Bijur Delimon gear spray nozzles and spray valves?
faqs.a: They are spray nozzles and spray-valve nozzle assemblies for Bijur Delimon gear spray systems, in round and rectangular patterns, for oil or grease. The listing has 21 part numbers plus SDU versions configured to order.

faqs.q: How do I read the Bijur Delimon SDU order code?
faqs.a: The SDU code is followed by one code from each position: nozzle (01 flat straight, 02 round straight, 03 flat 90°, 04 round 90°), revision A, monitoring (00 to 03), heating (O without, H with) and accessories (00 or 01). SDU01A00O00 is a valid example; 64 combinations exist.

faqs.q: What is the maximum pressure of Bijur Delimon gear spray nozzles?
faqs.a: The listing gives a maximum pressure of 500 psi (34 bar), for oil or grease. Check the rating of the nozzle against the pump and the lubricant before fitting.

faqs.q: What connections do Bijur Delimon gear spray nozzles have?
faqs.a: Fluid in and air in are 1/4 BSPT or 1/4 NPT, depending on the part number, for example AR1758 is a 1/4BSPT nozzle and U922C is a round assembly 1/4NPT. State the thread when you order.

faqs.q: What materials are the nozzles made from?
faqs.a: The material is plated brass or stainless steel; for example U922C is the round assembly and U922C-SS is the same part in stainless steel.

faqs.q: What nozzle patterns are available for gear spray?
faqs.a: Round and rectangular patterns, heavy-duty 2.4 mm nozzles, grease spray nozzles (63657-1431 rectangular, 63657-1441 round) and spray-valve nozzle assemblies. The SDU code adds flat or round, straight or 90° nozzles.

faqs.q: Which spray system do these nozzles fit?
faqs.a: They fit Bijur Delimon gear spray systems; see the [gear spray lances and kits](/p/bijur-delimon-gear-spray-lances-and-gear-spray-kits) for the lances they sit on. A TAG kit (55677) and an instrumentation grease seal (55741) are also listed.

faqs.q: Are Bijur Delimon gear spray nozzles and spray valves genuine parts?
faqs.a: Yes. Indus Hydraulics is an authorised Bijur Delimon distributor for the Middle East and supplies genuine units direct from the manufacturer, with the maker’s datasheets and manuals.

faqs.q: When should a gear spray nozzle be replaced?
faqs.a: Replace worn or clogged gear spray nozzles, since a clogged nozzle gives an uneven pattern. Clean, dry atomising air keeps the pattern even; see the [gear spray lubrication shelf](/c/gear-spray-lubrication).

faqs.q: Where are gear spray nozzles used?
faqs.a: They are used on open gears on mills, kilns and crushers, and to replace worn or clogged gear spray nozzles in existing systems.

faqs.q: Nozzle or complete spray valve assembly: which should I order?
faqs.a: Order the nozzle alone when only the tip is worn, and a spray valve nozzle assembly (for example 18830 or SC12) when the valve is damaged too. Send the old part number and the machine for a match.
